crossRefs.note: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
“My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.
before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’ ”
For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

translations.web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
translations.bsb: If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,
translations.kjv: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
translations.asv: If I look for Sheol as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;
